candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, the method only sets the new password and updates the user. It never revokes the user's existing sessions, such as with sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }). Sessions that were already signed in stay valid, so a device can still use its refresh token after the reset. The update() method does call deleteByUserIdWithExclude on password change, but resetPassword has no equivalent call.

fix.description: After usersService.update in resetPassword, call this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }) to invalidate all sessions and their refresh tokens.
